meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Queer Eye & Jersey Shore Cast Talk Reality TV, The Office & Parks & Rec Cast Talk Sitcom Life, Lin-Manuel Miranda & Darren Criss Talk Broadway & Beyond, K-Pop Demon Hunters Cast Secrets & Fandom Fun, Bad Bunny, CNCO & Becky G Talk Latin Pop & Fame
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
